# Test file watching functionality

# Single-file mode so the watched file is served at "/".
md2html -v -http :9029 watch_test.md &
wait-port :9029

# Initial content check
curl -s http://localhost:9029/
stdout 'Initial Content'

# Modify the file in place. The script engine's echo has no ">"
# redirection, so rewrite the watched file with replace.
replace 'Initial Content' 'Modified Content' watch_test.md
sleep 2s

curl -s http://localhost:9029/
stdout 'Modified Content'

# Directory mode: a file created after startup is served too. The staged
# copy keeps it out of the tree until the server is already watching.
md2html -v -http :9031 &
wait-port :9031

cp staged/new_file.md new_file.md
sleep 1s

curl -s http://localhost:9031/new_file
stdout 'New File'

# Stop the script; the background server is terminated with it.
stop

-- watch_test.md --
# Initial Content

This file will be modified during the test.

-- staged/new_file.md --
# New File
